metadata.model_family: balanced multinomial logistic regression on symmetric pair features
metadata.features: TF-IDF of character 3-4-grams of the normalised ingredient name; pair = [a+b, a*b]

training_data.source: DDInter category A only; `Unknown` pairs excluded (not labels)

metadata.intended_use: advisory estimate of the severity of an interaction that is already documented
not_for: deciding whether two drugs interact (no negative examples)

human adenovirus e serotype strain cl-68578 antigen
human botulinum neurotoxin a b immune globulin
human papillomavirus type l1 capsid protein antigen
influenza a virus a california h1n1 -like antigen
influenza a virus a vietnam h5n1 antigen
mumps virus strain b level jeryl lynn live antigen
vibrio cholerae cvd 103-hgr strain live antigen
